preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 8.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= ai <= 10**12 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer ai is between 2 and 10^12.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of vertices is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(ai in tree_vertices for ai in a)
postconditions.description: Each integer ai is included in the set of tree vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(tree_vertex == 1 or any(tree_vertex % child == 0 for child in children(tree_vertex)) for tree_vertex in tree_vertices)
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the tree is either 1 or divisible by all its children.

postconditions.expression: all(any(tree_vertex % ai == 0 for tree_vertex in tree_vertices) for ai in a)
postconditions.description: Each integer ai is a divisor of at least one vertex in the tree.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(len(tree_vertices) for tree_vertices in valid_trees(a))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum number of vertices among all valid divisor trees containing each ai.
